About Me

I'm Eluwade Peter Toluwanimi, a backend developer and AI engineer passionate about building smart, scalable, and user-focused digital solutions.

I specialize in backend development, AI engineering, and product-minded web development, helping brands, businesses, and creators grow their online presence through clean architecture, functional interfaces, and reliable systems. Every project I take on is built for both quality and performance.

My Journey

From Passion to Profession

My journey into tech started with curiosity — I wanted to understand how websites and online systems worked behind the scenes. What began as a hobby soon turned into a mission to create smarter, faster, and more responsive digital experiences.

After completing my studies in Computer Science and earning certifications in Web Development and Artificial Intelligence, I've dedicated my time to building websites, SEO-ready blogs, and digital tools that help businesses grow. Over time, I've collaborated with individuals and brands across different industries, delivering solutions that make a real impact.

Today, as Peter Lightspeed, I blend creative design with AI-driven development to build products that are not just beautiful but intelligent. My goal is simple — to help people and businesses stand out online through reliable, scalable, and meaningful digital experiences.
